name: rustfs
description: RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.
one_liner: A self-hosted alternative to Amazon S3 file storage that a company can run on its own hardware, cutting cloud storage bills while keeping the same file-upload tools it already uses.
buyer: A CTO at a data-heavy startup (video, AI training data, backups) whose S3 storage bill has grown large enough to justify running their own storage servers.
business_use_cases: A video or media company self-hosts it on owned hardware to cut a growing monthly S3 storage bill while keeping existing S3-compatible tooling.
A managed-hosting provider offers 'private S3-compatible storage' as a differentiated product for clients wary of cloud vendor lock-in.
An AI training-data company uses it as cheap, fast local storage for large datasets instead of paying cloud egress fees repeatedly.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting and migration services from S3/MinIO for companies wanting to cut storage costs
Provide paid support and SLA contracts for companies self-hosting it in production

steal_this: This weekend, write a clear migration guide and calculator showing exactly how much a mid-size S3 bill would drop by switching, then sell migration setup as a fixed-price service.
